## Purpose

Renders every pre-run surface for composing and launching a deliverable — the unified
Template/Design-System/Discovery launch wizard, the from-scratch agent-pipeline composer (list +
node-canvas views), the legacy card-select build panel, and the shared
agent-library/review-gates/capability chrome they all reuse.

**It owns nothing about a run once it starts streaming** — it hands off to
`frontend/src/components/chat` and the run screen's Preview/Steps/Files/Audit tabs the moment a
launch fires.

## Shape

Three parallel entry surfaces, all pipeline-agnostic (keyed on generic
`mode`/`pipelineType`/`workflowType` values, never a workflow name — the recurring
`SC-001`/`INV-1` guardrail in this directory's comments):

- [LaunchWizard.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/LaunchWizard.tsx) — the current unified prototype/ppt launch page. Owns brief + file/image
  attachments + template/design-system selection + the optional-agent budget, and wraps
  [WizardStepper.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/WizardStepper.tsx) (chrome-only Template → Design System → Discovery stepper) which slots in
  [prototype/TemplateGallery.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/prototype/TemplateGallery.tsx) / [ppt/PPTTemplateGallery.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/ppt/PPTTemplateGallery.tsx) /
  [prototype/DesignSystemPicker.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/prototype/DesignSystemPicker.tsx) / [prototype/DiscoveryForm.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/prototype/DiscoveryForm.tsx). Reads [AgentLibraryData.ts](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/AgentLibraryData.ts)
  for default agent lineups and opens [AgentsPopup.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/AgentsPopup.tsx) for the advanced agent composer.
- [composer/ComposerPage.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/composer/ComposerPage.tsx) — the from-scratch custom-workflow builder (`workflowType="custom"`
  and edit-from-catalogue). Owns one shared data model (`pipelineAgents: AgentDef[]` order plus
  `SelectionsMap`/`StepSelection`, both types re-exported from [AgentsPopup.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/AgentsPopup.tsx)) and renders it
  two ways via a Simple/Canvas toggle: a linear [composer/AgentRow.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/composer/AgentRow.tsx) list (Simple) or
  [composer/CanvasView.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/composer/CanvasView.tsx) + [composer/CanvasNode.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/composer/CanvasNode.tsx) + [composer/CanvasConfigRail.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/composer/CanvasConfigRail.tsx) (a
  hand-laid-out SVG node graph, Canvas). [composer/IdentityCard.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/composer/IdentityCard.tsx) and [composer/SummaryRail.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/composer/SummaryRail.tsx)
  are read/edit surfaces over the same state. Save goes through `createUserWorkflow`; Run-once
  reuses the existing `onStartPipeline` seam via `resolveDispatchType` imported from
  [IdeaInputPage.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/IdeaInputPage.tsx) (no parallel dispatch path).
- [WorkflowView.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/WorkflowView.tsx) — an older, self-contained select → build → running → complete panel (dark
  "VelocityAI Design Studio" skin, its own `FEATURE_CARDS`) still mounted for the
  embedded/dialog launch path. Its running/complete steps render [PipelineGraph.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/PipelineGraph.tsx) +
  [AgentNode.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/AgentNode.tsx) against a `PipelineRunState` prop the parent streams in live.
- [IdeaInputPage.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/IdeaInputPage.tsx) — the custom-workflow / meta-pipeline (e.g. Mulesoft→Spring Boot)
  idea-input surface; owns brief-based agent recommendations (`getAgentRecommendations`,
  `COMPANION_GROUPS`) that [ComposerPage.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/composer/ComposerPage.tsx) imports directly rather than duplicating.

Shared chrome consumed by more than one entry surface: [AgentsPopup.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/AgentsPopup.tsx) (the agent
add/remove/reorder modal, capability palette (`CapabilityPaletteSection.tsx`), skills/hooks tab,
and the `SelectionsMap`/`StepSelection`/`getRole`/`PIPELINE_LABEL` exports that are this module's
de facto shared-state contract), [AgentLibrary.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/AgentLibrary.tsx) + [AgentLibraryData.ts](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/AgentLibraryData.ts) (the agent catalog
and default per-pipeline lineups), [ReviewGatesSection.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/ReviewGatesSection.tsx) (pause-after-agent selection),
[SkillManager.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/SkillManager.tsx), [TokenUsageSummary.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/workflow/TokenUsageSummary.tsx).

**No component in this module opens its own SSE/WebSocket connection.** Live run state
(`PipelineRunState`, `AgentRunState`) always arrives as a prop threaded down from the
run-screen/dashboard composition root (`[MOD-frontend-src-app](MOD-frontend-src-app.md)` / `[MOD-frontend-src-components-layout](MOD-frontend-src-components-layout.md)`)
— the boundary between "composing a run" (this module) and "watching a run" (`components/chat`,
`components/results`) is a prop handoff, not a subscription owned here.

## Why this shape

Three entry points exist because the product has three distinct compose-time jobs —
pick-a-template-and-go, build-a-pipeline-from-scratch, and the legacy card-select flow kept
alive for an embedded/dialog context — and each earns its own top-level component rather than
one component branching on a mode enum.

What is **not** duplicated across them is the actual pipeline-editing primitives: `AgentsPopup`'s
`SelectionsMap`/`StepSelection` types and `AgentLibraryData`'s catalog are imported everywhere
agents are added, removed, or reordered, so a capability or gate rule only has to be correct
once. The repeated `SC-001`/`INV-1` comments enforce that every branch point is data (a
`mode`/`pipelineType` value from `AgentLibraryData`/the launch-contract library) rather than a
per-workflow code path — this is what let `LaunchWizard` merge two previously route-split pages
without becoming a workflow-name switch statement.

**Keeping SSE/live-state entirely out of this module is deliberate**: composer components must
render identically whether backed by mocked test data or a live stream, so all "is a run
happening" state stays a passed-in prop rather than a fetch/subscription this module would
otherwise have to fake in tests.
